description: Extreme events overwhelm public systems and expose institutional fragility.
Consumption continues while ecological and social stress accumulate.
Adaptation benefits wealthier actors while exposed communities face worsening risk.
Green investment expands while unequal power extraction and labor insecurity persist.
Technology accelerates green transition but creates governance extraction and distributional challenges.
Regional systems strengthen food water energy ecological and community resilience.
Coordinated public policy investment ecological restoration and social protection support sustainability transition.
Justice ecological repair public investment and democratic legitimacy support transformation.
